title: Payment Gateway Infrastructure Runbook
content: In case of payment gateway timeouts (HTTP 504), check the Redis cache connection pool. Restart the payment-service pod using 'kubectl rollout restart deployment/payment-service'. If error rates exceed 5%, trigger incident management protocol.

title: INC-2025-089 Payment Timeout Outage Report
content: Incident INC-2025-089: Payment failures observed during high-traffic promotional events. Root Cause: Connection pool exhaustion in the primary database combined with Third-Party Payment Gateway HTTP 504 responses. Solution: Scaled database pool size and implemented circuit breaker pattern.

title: Commercial Banking Core Security Policy
content: All customer payment data must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit via TLS 1.3. Administrative tools must require multi-factor authentication (MFA) and strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

title: System Architecture - User Authentication Service
content: The Auth Service uses OAuth2 with JWT tokens for stateless authorization. Rate limiting is enforced via Token Bucket algorithm at 20 requests per minute per user.
